items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I was just called... that may not be my solo on Rod Stewart’s record.

ctx.x: I have had students that just had to play that you know. They really want to get that sax lick down the way you did it. It’s kind of hard. Tell me about the Rod Stewart thing, how that came about.

I was just called. I’ve read recently that with the advent of multi-track, producers many times would call several soloists to play the same solo. And so I found out recently that that may not be my solo on Rod Stewart’s record.
